description:
Which part watches the stack from outside it, whether it answers, and what each of its
monitors sees beside what it covers.

monitors.description: Every monitor it holds, the operator's and lemonfiber's.

reachable.description: Whether the watcher answers. False is coverage nobody can see, never all clear.

read_at.description: When it was asked, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

uncovered.description: Every critical service and household entry point no active monitor covers.

unreachable_because.description: Why it does not answer, where it does not.

watcher.description: The plugin filling `status.watch`, where one does.
